reviews.title: Beautiful case if you’re willing to spend money
reviews.comment: Absolutely phenomenal case. Aesthetically beautiful, and keeps my system icy. Very sturdy and strong case too. I 100% recommend this case to anyone looking for a new case. It’s worth the cost imo!!
reviews.author: CodyH

reviews.title: Best case I ever owned. (Best of 17 purchased in last 20 years.)
reviews.comment:
I love it. Easy to build it. Tons of space and room. I would watch a build video on YouTube though. There are a few areas that have to be done in a specific order to not have to re-do things. I watched the videos before it arrived and knew all those spots so for me it wasn't an issue.
It is a very wide case. But height wise about typical. It reduced my temps 5c vs my last case. Great airflow. It also has top tier dust control. Filter on bottom pre-installed and optional filter in box for the AIO chamber.
The only thing wrong with this case is the price. But unlike some other expensive cases I have purchased in the past, this one actually feels and looks significantly more premium. It also had the thickest foam padding I have ever seen for a case or computer I have ordered before.
I am really happy with this purchase. I doubt you will be disappointed.
reviews.author: Jeff

reviews.title: Built like a tank and might be the last case I ever buy for all my builds
reviews.comment: This case is an investment well worth the money. I see myself never having to upgrade my case for my future builds, so I can easily seeing this case lasting me well over two decades or more. I have had other cases that weren't as well made and built with quality material like this Corsair Air 5400 and those have lasted well over a decade, so this one being built like a tank will definitely last longer as long as you handle the doors with care. It's a hefty case and wide as it's a triple chamber case, so keep it in one spot and it will last you a long time. The triple chamber innovation is definitely on point as it deviates the hot air from your CPU AIO directly out of the open chamber. It looks super clean, well made, allows you to manage and hide cables from view, and is easy to work with when installing your components. I really love this case and plan on using this over and over. I just built my new rig so this is going to be protecting some expensive components as well as showcasing those components in an organized and clean way. I really like that the metal has no sharp corners so there's no chance of accidentally cutting a finger or jabbing yourself while putting your rig together. The finish is top notch and honestly, I could see this selling for more than it is. So, there's still a lot of value even at the current market rate.
reviews.author: A. L.

reviews.title: Perfect, Only One Minor Drawback
reviews.comment: Love the case. I picked up the TITAN 360 LCD and a triple pack of LX 120 fans to match the case fans. Some Dominator Titanium RAM too. The build looks amazing and does a excellent job of cooling as expected. I'm down one star just because of the PSU slot placement. For some reason, it's a bit high in the case. The stock 12vhpwr cable that came with my power supply won't reach from the GPU down under the motherboard then up to where the connection is to the PSU. So I have to route it off to the side of the motherboard to reach. It just doesn't look as orderly as it would if that cable was run under the bottom of the motherboard. Just cleaner aesthetics in what is definitely an aesthetic case.
